description: CanDo default job architecture: career tracks and levels, with starter job families. Loaded as the CAREER_LEVEL and JOB_FAMILY tenant code schemes (docs/18 §3) when a tenant switches them on; every value can be renamed, removed or added to. Defaults for competency targets, TEER and job evaluation points are proposals used for suggestions and consistency warnings, never for blocking (docs/19 §3).
scale_reference: Competency levels refer to the five-level scale of rules/competencies/unified-competency-model.json (1 Foundational … 5 Strategic). Points refer to rules/job-evaluation/sample-point-factor-plan.json (180 to 1000).

tracks.summary_en: Work that follows established procedures, from routine tasks to skilled and lead-hand work: administration, client service, facilities, trades and operations.
tracks.summary_fr: Travail qui suit des procédures établies, des tâches courantes au travail spécialisé et de chef d’équipe : administration, service à la clientèle, installations, métiers et opérations.

tracks.summary_en: Individual contributors who apply a body of professional or technical knowledge, from new graduates to recognized experts. No people management, though senior levels may direct others' work.
tracks.summary_fr: Contributeurs individuels qui appliquent un ensemble de connaissances professionnelles ou techniques, du nouveau diplômé à l’expert reconnu. Aucune gestion de personnel, même si les niveaux supérieurs peuvent orienter le travail des autres.

tracks.summary_en: Leaders accountable for other people's work: hiring, direction, performance and pay recommendations, from first-line supervisors to directors.
tracks.summary_fr: Leaders responsables du travail d’autres personnes : embauche, direction, rendement et recommandations salariales, du superviseur de premier niveau au directeur.

tracks.summary_en: The executive team: heads of major functions and the chief executive, accountable for strategy and results of the whole organization.
tracks.summary_fr: L’équipe de direction : responsables des grandes fonctions et premier dirigeant, responsables de la stratégie et des résultats de l’ensemble de l’organisation.

levels.summary_en: Performs routine, well-defined tasks after a short orientation, with work checked often.
levels.summary_fr: Effectue des tâches courantes et bien définies après une brève initiation; le travail est vérifié souvent.

dimensions.autonomy: Close guidance; clear instructions for each task
dimensions.problem_solving: Recognizes when something is not routine and refers it
dimensions.influence: Own work; courteous contact with clients and colleagues

levels.summary_en: Carries out a range of standard tasks independently once trained, choosing among set procedures.
levels.summary_fr: Exécute de façon autonome, après formation, un éventail de tâches standard en choisissant parmi des procédures établies.

dimensions.autonomy: Works from procedures; checks in on exceptions
dimensions.problem_solving: Solves routine problems using established methods
dimensions.influence: Own work and the clients served

levels.summary_en: Handles varied and sometimes complex work that needs specialized training or a trade, and helps train others.
levels.summary_fr: Traite un travail varié et parfois complexe qui exige une formation spécialisée ou un métier, et aide à former les autres.

dimensions.scope: A full process or service area
dimensions.influence: Peers and clients; trains new staff

levels.summary_en: The most experienced support or skilled work: leads a crew or shift, or is the go-to specialist for a process, without formal people management.
levels.summary_fr: Le travail de soutien ou spécialisé le plus expérimenté : dirige une équipe ou un quart, ou est le spécialiste de référence d’un processus, sans gestion formelle du personnel.

dimensions.problem_solving: Resolves non-standard problems and improves procedures
dimensions.influence: The team's daily work and quality

levels.summary_en: Applies professional or technical knowledge, usually from a degree or diploma, to defined assignments while building experience.
levels.summary_fr: Applique des connaissances professionnelles ou techniques, généralement acquises par un diplôme, à des mandats définis tout en acquérant de l’expérience.

dimensions.scope: Defined assignments or a small caseload
dimensions.problem_solving: Solves problems with known methods; asks on new ones

levels.summary_en: Fully competent in the discipline; handles the normal range of work independently and judges when to escalate.
levels.summary_fr: Pleinement compétent dans sa discipline; traite de façon autonome l’éventail normal du travail et juge quand faire appel à d’autres.

dimensions.scope: A full caseload, program component or professional area
dimensions.problem_solving: Analyses moderately complex problems and chooses among approaches
dimensions.influence: Clients, peers and partners on own files

levels.summary_en: Handles the most complex work in the discipline, advises others and leads projects; may guide junior staff.
levels.summary_fr: Traite le travail le plus complexe de la discipline, conseille les autres et dirige des projets; peut guider le personnel moins expérimenté.

dimensions.scope: Complex files, projects or a professional program area
dimensions.problem_solving: Develops new approaches where precedents are limited

levels.summary_en: Recognized authority in a field inside the organization; sets methods and standards and advises leaders.
levels.summary_fr: Autorité reconnue dans un domaine au sein de l’organisation; établit les méthodes et les normes et conseille les dirigeants.

dimensions.scope: A field of practice across the organization
dimensions.problem_solving: Resolves the hardest problems in the field; anticipates new ones
dimensions.influence: Leaders, funders and external bodies on the field

levels.summary_en: Rare level for an expert whose work shapes the organization's direction or its sector; usually only in large organizations.
levels.summary_fr: Niveau rare pour un expert dont le travail oriente l’organisation ou son secteur; généralement seulement dans les grandes organisations.

dimensions.autonomy: Defines problems as well as solutions

levels.summary_en: First-line leader of a team or shift: assigns and checks work, coaches, and takes part in hiring and performance decisions.
levels.summary_fr: Leader de premier niveau d’une équipe ou d’un quart : attribue et vérifie le travail, encadre et participe aux décisions d’embauche et de rendement.

dimensions.autonomy: Operates within a manager's plan and budget
dimensions.problem_solving: Solves operational problems; escalates policy issues

levels.summary_en: Manages a program, service or function through staff and supervisors: plans, budgets, hires and is accountable for results.
levels.summary_fr: Gère un programme, un service ou une fonction par l’entremise de son personnel et de superviseurs : planifie, budgète, embauche et répond des résultats.

dimensions.autonomy: Sets plans within the department's direction

levels.summary_en: Leads several programs or a large function through managers; shapes plans and policies for the area.
levels.summary_fr: Dirige plusieurs programmes ou une grande fonction par l’entremise de gestionnaires; façonne les plans et les politiques du secteur.

dimensions.scope: Several programs or a large function
dimensions.autonomy: Direction from an executive; wide discretion
dimensions.problem_solving: Resolves issues that cross programs and functions

levels.summary_en: Heads a department or major function below the executive team; sets its strategy, structure and budget.
levels.summary_fr: Dirige un service ou une grande fonction sous l’équipe de direction; en établit la stratégie, la structure et le budget.

dimensions.autonomy: Accountable to an executive for the department's results
dimensions.influence: The organization, funders and the community

levels.summary_en: Member of the executive team heading a major part of the organization, with directors or managers reporting in.
levels.summary_fr: Membre de l’équipe de direction à la tête d’une grande partie de l’organisation, avec des directeurs ou des gestionnaires sous sa responsabilité.

dimensions.scope: A major part of the organization
dimensions.autonomy: Accountable to the chief executive; shapes organization strategy
dimensions.influence: The board, governments, funders and the sector

levels.summary_en: The top position, reporting to the board; accountable for the mission, strategy and all operations.
levels.summary_fr: Le poste le plus élevé, relevant du conseil d’administration; responsable de la mission, de la stratégie et de toutes les opérations.

dimensions.influence: Board, members, governments and the public

people_values.work_direction: Assigns or checks others' work without formal people management
people_values.supervises: Formal people management of individual contributors
people_values.manages_managers: People management of supervisors or managers
people_values.leads_function: Leads a major function through managers

job_code_pattern.description: Recommended, not required: family + sub-family + level, for example CSV-YTH-P2 for a youth program professional. The pattern keeps survey matching simple because a job family and level can map to a survey's family and level in one step (docs/19 §6.3).

starter_job_families.name_fr: Services à la clientèle et à la communauté

sub_families.name_fr: Établissement et services aux nouveaux arrivants

consistency_rules.text_en: The job's NOC TEER is outside the level's typical TEER range. Check the level or the NOC code.
consistency_rules.text_fr: La catégorie FER (TEER) de la CNP de l’emploi est hors de la plage habituelle du niveau. Vérifiez le niveau ou le code CNP.

consistency_rules.text_en: The job's evaluated points are outside the level's typical range. Check the evaluation or the level.
consistency_rules.text_fr: Les points d’évaluation de l’emploi sont hors de la plage habituelle du niveau. Vérifiez l’évaluation ou le niveau.

consistency_rules.text_en: A management-track level is set but the position has no reports, or an individual-contributor level is set on a position with reports.
consistency_rules.text_fr: Un niveau du volet gestion est attribué, mais le poste n’a aucun subordonné, ou un niveau de contributeur individuel est attribué à un poste qui a des subordonnés.
